name: Sheet2Calendar — Idempotent Spreadsheet-to-Google Calendar Sync Engine
summary: Turns rows in your Google Sheet into timed or all-day Google Calendar events, writes each unique Event ID back to your sheet, and updates existing calendar entries automatically whenever your spreadsheet changes.
metaDescription: Turn Google Sheets rows into Google Calendar events with automatic Event ID writeback so updates never create duplicate events. Zero cloud rent.
